parameters.help_en: The model configuration as a JSON string
parameters.name: data

schema.description_en: The API response information, which includes the request ID, the success status of the call, and other result fields
schema.description_zh: 接口返回信息，包含请求 ID、调用是否成功以及其他结果字段

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The authentication diagnostics details returned when a permission check fails, including the authentication principal, operation, policy, and cause of denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 权限校验失败时返回的鉴权诊断详情，包含鉴权主体、操作、策略和拒绝原因

AuthAction.description_en: The authentication operation that triggered the access denied error, which can be used to troubleshoot the issue or grant the required permissions
AuthAction.description_zh: 触发无权限错误的鉴权操作，可用于排查或授予所需权限

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the authentication principal. The display format varies for RAM users, RAM roles, and SSO federated identities
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份标识；RAM 用户、RAM 角色和 SSO 联合身份的展示形式不同

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the authentication principal belongs
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 鉴权主体所属阿里云账号的 UID

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The identity type of the authentication principal, such as a RAM user, a RAM role, or an SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份类型，例如 RAM 用户、RAM 角色或 SSO 联合身份

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_en: The encoded diagnostics message for the access denied error. An authorized account administrator can decode this message to troubleshoot the cause of the denial
EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 无权限错误的编码诊断信息，可交由具备权限的账号管理员解码以排查拒绝原因

NoPermissionType.description_en: The cause type of the access denied error, which distinguishes between lack of explicit authorization and explicit denial
NoPermissionType.description_zh: 无权限原因类型，区分未被显式授权和被显式拒绝

PolicyType.description_en: The type of the policy that caused the access denied error, such as a control policy, a session policy, or an identity-based policy
PolicyType.description_zh: 导致无权限的策略类型，例如管控策略、会话策略或基于身份的策略

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which corresponds to the requestId request parameter

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
